LanguageData.MooGirl_Charge.description: Carriers of this gene possess explosive power, allowing them to accelerate toward enemies in a short time. It is said to be a traditional way to embrace the glory of battle.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Charge.label: Mugirl Charge!
LanguageData.MooGirl_NobelPrize.description: Carriers of this gene learn slowly, but fortunately have strong memory. Even a Mugirl might win a Nobel-ish prize!
LanguageData.MooGirl_NobelPrize.label: Mugirl Nobel Memory!
LanguageData.MooGirl_Shooting.description: Carriers of this gene are impatient, like firing wildly, and dislike careful aiming.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Shooting.label: Mugirl Bang-Bang-Bang!
LanguageData.MooGirl_Shout.description: Carriers of this gene have a unique roar. This strange cry provokes nearby enemies into attacking them, functioning as a taunt. (RUA~!)
LanguageData.MooGirl_Shout.label: Mugirl Shout!
